name: Search Field
description: A search box with a clear button, a pending state and a keyboard shortcut hint.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field. Without one, give it an aria-label.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

props.name: isPending
props.description: The lens draws in its handle and turns into a spinning ring until the results arrive.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A key hint shown at the right while the field is empty, such as "/" or "⌘K". Pressing it anywhere on the page focuses the field.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when the field is cleared with Escape or the clear button.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the outlined box.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components SearchField.
